# TEST ONLY. Theme scope. Halves the regiments of each of the theme's armies (rounded down: an army of one
# regiment keeps it; no army is emptied), so that the replenishment (tqnow) finds the theme short. destroy_subunit
# on part of an army's subunits is vanilla's own form (events/DHE/flavor_GEN.txt, ordered_sub_unit ... max = 10).
# oe_tb2_h0 / oe_tb2_h1: regiments before / after, on the theme (read by tb2log; the count may only update later).
oe_tb2_test_halve = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_h0 value = oe_tb2_test_regs }
    every_army = {
        limit = { oe_tb2_unit_half >= 1 }
        ordered_sub_unit = {
            limit = { is_regiment = yes }
            max = oe_tb2_unit_half
            check_range_bounds = no
            destroy_subunit = yes
        }
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_tb2_h1 value = oe_tb2_test_regs }
}
# TEST ONLY. Theme scope. Loyalty 60 and band 2 now (the next monthly pulse recomputes both), so that a theme of a
# fresh 1337 game (loyalty 0) passes the replenishment's loyalty line and the 'set as advised' band.
oe_tb2_test_loyal = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty value = 60 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_theme_loyalty_band value = 2 }
}
